_readme: Values that Design Tokens (DTCG) 2025.10 has no type for, so they cannot live in tokens.json. Today that is one CSS keyword, step-end: the standard's easing type, cubicBezier, takes four numbers and nothing else (format module section 8.6), and a token with no valid type is invalid (section 8). scripts/lib/tokens.mjs reads this file after tokens.json and puts each entry back in the place `after` names, so the generated CSS is the same as it was before the move. An entry is { path, value } or { path, ref }, with `after` the sibling token it follows.
